headline: Reviewer decisions should happen before answer confidence.
copy: This desk turns retrieval matches into visible decisions. The candidate is not the answer; it is a review object.

steps.title: Inspect
steps.copy: Read source family, citation, status, and missing fields.

steps.title: Decide
steps.copy: Accept, hold, return, or block the match.

steps.title: Explain
steps.copy: Leave one reason for the next reviewer.

steps.title: Packet
steps.copy: Only accepted candidates feed answer packets.

candidates.title: Steady action
candidates.reason: Question asks about calm action while results are uncertain.

record.title: Steadiness in action
record.allowedUse: Use for calm path, practice, and learner action cards.
record.boundary: Reflection support only, not therapy, diagnosis, or ritual instruction.
record.summary: The source candidate supports steadiness while acting, with caution about clinging to results.

candidates.packet: Decision: Accept for prototype\nReason: Direct source candidate, clear use lane, visible boundary.\nMissing: licensed translation before production.

candidates.title: Oppenheimer source
candidates.reason: Question asks to identify the scripture behind a popular quote.

record.title: Time and destruction
record.allowedUse: Use for Oppenheimer-source clarification and category correction.
record.boundary: Do not call it a direct Vedic quote or a four-Veda passage.
record.summary: This is the commonly cited source family behind the Oppenheimer line in popular culture.

candidates.packet: Decision: Accept with category caution\nReason: Corrects Gita versus four Vedas confusion.\nBoundary: Do not call direct Vedic quote.

candidates.title: Gayatri source
candidates.reason: Question asks about mantra identity and meaning.

record.title: Gayatri mantra source
record.allowedUse: Use for source identification and respectful boundary notes.
record.boundary: Do not provide ritual authority, initiation guidance, or overconfident practice instruction.
record.summary: A central Vedic mantra source that needs special care around recitation, tradition, and context.

candidates.packet: Decision: Hold for tradition review\nReason: Source identity is strong, but practice and recitation boundaries need reviewer approval.

candidates.title: Modern science claim
candidates.reason: Question attempts to prove a modern theory through scripture.

record.title: Devotional definition candidate
record.allowedUse: Use only as a future source placeholder.
record.boundary: Do not use for final answers until exact sutra and tradition notes are reviewed.
record.summary: Potential bhakti source lane for future devotional learning paths.

candidates.packet: Decision: Block answer claim\nReason: No verified source supports the claim. Return a claim-check response.
